svg.title: MealMind — Restaurant ecosystem · 3 Flutter apps
svg.desc: Feature 6 of 6: MealMind — Restaurant ecosystem · 3 Flutter apps. Status: built. One payment, three apps, under a second. Customer, chef and admin apps on one Firebase backend: a confirmed Razorpay payment reaches the kitchen screen and the admin dashboard in under a second. Fig. 9, one payment, every screen: 1. Pay — Razorpay, in the customer app; 2. Confirm — webhook → Cloud Function; 3. Sync — one Firestore write, every app — reaching the customer, chef and admin apps in under a second. Stack: Flutter ×3, Firestore, Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, Razorpay.
